# Verifier back-test on the bench fixtures

Each fixture is 35 days of synthetic history with no real step in it. 300 placebo steps (seed 1) are replayed through verification v2 and, for comparison, v1; the same placebos with a synthetic 30% drop in blocks per call give the detection rate. See docs/verification.md for the method.

| Fixture | Usable placebos | Excluded | v2 false positives | v2 Wilson 95% upper | v2 inconclusive | v2 detection | v1 false positives | v1 detection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `seasonal-week` | 300 | 0 | 0% | 1.26% | 0% | 100% | 0% | 100% |
| `traffic-shift` | 300 | 0 | 0% | 1.26% | 0% | 100% | 8.67% | 94.67% |
| `noisy-neighbour` | 300 | 0 | 1% | 2.9% | 3.33% | 99.33% | 7.33% | 96.33% |
| `deploy-breaks` | 247 | 53 | 0% | 1.53% | 0% | 100% | 0% | 100% |
| `weekly-only-targets` | 300 | 0 | 0% | 1.26% | 25.67% | 74.33% | 0% | 74.33% |

The gate verify.method auto reads needs at least 200 usable placebos, a false-positive rate at or below 5% and a detection rate at or above 80%:

- `seasonal-week`: passes
- `traffic-shift`: passes
- `noisy-neighbour`: passes
- `deploy-breaks`: passes
- `weekly-only-targets`: refused: detection 74.33% below 80%
